features.name: Map browsing and viewport state
steps: Open the map
Drag the map to browse other areas
Use + / - to change the zoom level
Place names, roads, POIs, and rivers re-layout with the zoom level
Open the place details and then close them
It returns to the original map area rather than resetting the viewport.
features.expected: The map features must be redrawn dynamically with the zoom level, and the density of roads, POIs, and place names changes accordingly; opening and closing the place details must not reset the viewport; the viewport state is preserved after panning and zooming.

features.name: Current location and re-centering
steps: Get the device's current location
The map shows the user with a blue location dot
The user drags away from the current location
Tap the locate button
The map re-centers on the current location
After a location change the user position on the map updates in sync.
features.expected: The location dot must reflect the real device position; the re-center button must move the map back to the current location; after a location change the blue dot and heading update in sync; reasonable feedback is required when location permission is missing or positioning fails.

features.name: Map style and layers
steps: Open "map style and layers"
Switch between "subway / contour lines / outdoors / hiking / cycling"
The map immediately changes which roads, tracks, contour lines, or transport networks are emphasized
The selection is preserved after closing the panel
Reopening still shows the current style.
features.expected: Each style must genuinely change the map rendering, with subway, contour lines, outdoors, hiking, and cycling emphasizing different elements; switching takes effect immediately; the selection persists across closing the panel and restarting.

features.name: Offline map-area lifecycle
steps: Choose an area that has not been downloaded yet
Start downloading map data
Show the download/completion state
After completing the current instance the next periodic instance is produced / the next due time advances
After disconnecting the network, the map, roads, and places within downloaded areas remain usable
After the map is updated the local data can be updated again. Offline maps and offline search are core Organic Maps capabilities. Organic Maps
features.expected: The download must genuinely save that map area's data and show progress and a completion state; after going offline the roads and places in the downloaded area are still browsable and searchable; after an update the local data is replaced with the new version; undownloaded areas should show as unavailable.

features.name: Text search and search history
steps: Open search from the map
Enter a place, road, or name
Return the matching results
After selecting a result the search closes and the map moves to the target position
Re-entering the search keeps the previous query in the history
Clear or reuse a history entry
Enable Resize on an image with an alpha channel or obvious edges
features.expected: The search results must match the map data and be able to locate the target; the history is kept by time and can be cleared; downloaded areas must support offline search; a no-result state should give feedback rather than a blank.

features.name: Category place discovery
steps: Open search
Switch between "history / categories"
Choose categories such as "where to eat, hotels, tourist attractions, transport, gas stations, parking, and shopping"
Return the corresponding POIs for the current map area or current location
Re-run the search after moving the map
The results stay consistent with the place positions on the map.
features.expected: The category results must be filtered by the current viewport or position and match the actual POI locations on the map; after moving the map the re-run results update accordingly; the result count matches the visible POIs.

features.name: Place selection and the details page
steps: Tap a city, road, park, or other POI on the map
Bring up the place details
Show the name, type, distance/direction, and available coordinates
When additional materials exist, show the Wikipedia summary, website, etc.
After moving to a different place the details switch to the correct object. The official Organic Maps also lists Wikipedia place information as a feature. Organic Maps
features.expected: The details content must match the tapped object, including basic information such as the name and type; when additional materials exist, Wikipedia or the website is shown; after switching places the details are fully replaced with no leftover data from the previous place.

features.name: Two-way sync of saving / un-saving a place
steps: Tap "save" from the place details
Create a Place–Bookmark relationship
The place on the map becomes saved
The place appears in the corresponding list under "bookmarks and tracks"
Delete/unfavorite from the list
Returning to the original map place restores the unsaved state
The results stay consistent after refreshing the app.
features.expected: The saved state must stay consistent across the details page, the map markers, and the bookmark list; un-saving from any entry syncs the other views; the relationship persists and stays consistent after a refresh or restart.

features.name: Bookmark list and visibility management
steps: Open "bookmarks and tracks"
Create a new list
After raising the quality the visual quality and file size are restored
After hiding a list its bookmarks disappear from the map but the data still exists
It is restored after being shown again
Operations such as "hide all" should affect map visibility at the same time without deleting data.
features.expected: Hiding only changes map visibility and the bookmark data must be preserved; showing it again restores it; a bookmark can belong to several lists; the list visibility settings must persist and hiding must not delete any data.

features.name: Bookmark and track import / export
steps: Choose import from "bookmarks and tracks"
Choose a file containing bookmarks or tracks
After parsing, the places/tracks are added to the corresponding list and shown on the map
Export the order file
Generate a data file that can be imported again

After re-importing, the places, track geometry, and main attributes stay consistent. The official app currently supports KML/KMZ/KMB, GPX, GeoJSON, and other imports, and can export KMZ, GPX, and GeoJSON. Organic Maps

features.name: Build a route from a place
steps: Select a place from the search results, a map POI, or a bookmark
Tap "directions" to create the destination
The current location is used as the start point by default
The route panel shows the start and end points
You can also change the start point from a place using "start from here"
The route is generated on the map and shows the estimated time and distance. Organic Maps
features.expected: The route must contain an explicit start and end point, with the start defaulting to the current location; "start from here" must change the start point and recompute; the distance and estimated time shown in the panel must correspond to the actual route geometry.

features.name: Multi-transport-mode route switching
steps: Completed orders
Select car, walking, public transport, cycling, and straight line/Ruler in turn
Every switch recomputes the route geometry, distance, estimated time, and the corresponding map rendering
Merely changing the icon while keeping the same route is not allowed. The official routes page also lists these five modes. Organic Maps
features.expected: Each transport mode must generate different route geometry and time estimates rather than only changing the icon; after switching, the distance and time are recomputed; walking and cycling follow the actual road network and straight-line mode uses geometric distance.

features.name: Alternative routes and route selection
steps: Compute routes for the same start and end points
The map shows two or more alternative routes at the same time with their times, e.g. 19/25 minutes in the screenshot
The user taps another candidate route
Main-route highlighting, time, and distance switching
Subsequent navigation uses the currently selected route. The official 2026 update has added alternative routes. Organic Maps
features.expected: Alternative routes must genuinely exist with different geometry and times; after tapping a candidate the main-route highlight and the time/distance switch in sync; starting navigation must use the currently selected route.

features.name: Head Pose
steps: The start and end points are already set
Tap "add stop"
Select a third place from the map/search
Waypoints inserted into the route
Drag the sort handle in the list to change the waypoint order
The route, total distance, and time are recomputed
After deleting a stop the corresponding two-point route is restored.
features.expected: Waypoints must take part in the route computation in list order; after drag-reordering the total distance and time are recomputed; after deleting a waypoint it reverts to the corresponding two-point route; the map geometry matches the list order.

features.name: Route statistics and elevation information
steps: Generate a walking or cycling route
Show the distance and estimated duration
If the song is in the play queue the queue is removed in sync or handled according to the player rules
Switch routes or change waypoints
The chart and statistics immediately correspond to the new route rather than using static data.
features.expected: The distance and duration must be computed from the actual route; when elevation data exists the profile and cumulative ascent/descent must correspond to the current route; after switching routes or adding/removing waypoints the charts and statistics update in sync and must not use static data.

features.name: Route preferences and road avoidance
steps: Create a car route
Open route settings
Change the avoidance conditions such as toll roads, unpaved roads, highways, and ferries
Recompute the path
The route geometry, distance, and time respond to configuration changes
Returning to the settings still preserves the current preferences. The official routing documentation explicitly provides these avoidance options. Organic Maps
features.expected: The avoidance options must genuinely change the path selection and geometry, with the distance and time changing accordingly; the preferences persist and remain effective in subsequent computations; after disabling avoidance the route can resume passing the corresponding roads.

features.name: The navigation state machine for starting/ending navigation
steps: Plan a valid route
Tap "start"
Enter the Navigation state from Preview
The GPS position updates along the route
The direction of the next step, the remaining distance/time, and the voice prompts change with progress
Recompute when the user deviates from the route

After ending navigation it returns to the normal map without losing bookmarks, map positions, and other data. The official Organic Maps supports turn-by-turn walking, cycling, and car navigation with voice guidance. Organic Maps
features.expected: Starting and ending navigation must transition correctly between the Preview and Navigation states; the remaining distance and time update as the position decreases; after deviating from the route it is recomputed; after ending, bookmarks, map positions, and other data are preserved.

features.name: Public-transport multi-segment routes
steps: Start and end points set
Select public transport
The system combines "walking
Bus/subway/light rail/tram
Walking" segments
The map draws each segment separately
The panel shows the line numbers and transfer relationships

After changing the start/end points or transport mode the old segments are replaced entirely. In your screenshot bus 22 and a walking segment are visible; the current official version already supports subway, light rail, bus, and tram routes. Organic Maps
features.expected: A transit route must consist of several distinguishable walking and riding segments; the panel shows the line numbers and transfer relationships; after changing the start/end points or transport mode the old segments are replaced entirely with no leftovers.
